definitions.explanation: The number of years since a building was constructed, an important factor in real estate.

examples.japanese: このマンションは{築年数|ちくねんすう}が20{年|ねん}だ。
examples.english: This apartment building is 20 years old.

examples.japanese: {築年数|ちくねんすう}が{浅|あさ}い{物件|ぶっけん}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a property that's relatively new.

examples.japanese: {築年数|ちくねんすう}が{経|た}っている{分|ぶん}、{家賃|やちん}が{安|やす}い。
examples.english: The rent is cheap because the building is older.

notes:
REAL ESTATE TERM:
A key factor in property valuations. Generally, older buildings have lower rent/prices but may have different characteristics.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{築年数|ちくねんすう}が{浅|あさ}い - relatively new (lit. "shallow years")
・{築年数|ちくねんすう}が{経|た}っている - older building
・{築|ちく}◯{年|ねん} - ◯ years old (e.g., {築|ちく}10{年|ねん} = 10 years old)

RELATED TERMS:
・{築|ちく}◯{年|ねん} - ◯ years old (shorter form in listings)
・{新築|しんちく} - newly constructed
・{中古|ちゅうこ} - second-hand, pre-owned
